statement: For each canonical weight difference Delta_n1(Dweight), Delta_n2(Dweight), Delta_n3(Dweight), Delta_k(Dweight), and Delta_l(Dweight), every nested coordinate lies in the span of exactly three protected combinations N11, N12k, N12l.

derivation.n_shift_reason: The nested atoms depend only on k,l, so r22_nested cancels in every n-shift difference; only the n-dependent one-body coefficients of N11/N12k/N12l change.
derivation.spatial_shift_reason: Every protected U/ES shift is the same nested atom plus a one-body rational/harmonic increment. Therefore r22_nested contributes only to the one-body sector after subtraction, while the surviving nested coordinates remain N11/N12k/N12l.

full_residual_consequence: Multiplication by the temporal rational coefficients and by the regularized symmetric Q-row flux cannot enlarge the nested coordinate span. Hence the nested part of the four-channel direct E_D residual lies in span{N11,N12k,N12l}.
corrected_probe_note: An earlier exploratory Wolfram probe omitted explicit multiplication signs and was discarded. The retained statement rests on exact canonical-map coefficient relations, not that probe.
next_exact_obligation: Exploit the three nested auxiliary modules and the complementary one-body sector separately, beginning with natural inner-sum certificates for N11, N12k, and N12l; do not return to the generic 198-dimensional flux ansatz.
